body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). Seven test files in plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test and plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test manually invoke mkdtempSync and guard removals in try/finally blocks, and are allowlisted in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs. With @adlc/core/test-kit (tmp), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via t.after when passed the test context t.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/:
   - In build-gate-space-path.test.mjs, build-gate.test.mjs, handoff-deny.test.mjs, handoff-resolve-global-e2e.test.mjs, handoff-secret-scrub.test.mjs:
     * Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
     * Update test declarations to accept t parameter from test(...).
     * Replace mkdtempSync calls with tmp(t, prefix).
     * Remove manual try { ... } finally { rmSync(dir, ...); } blocks, unindenting test bodies.
2. In plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/:
   - In build-gate-space-path.test.mjs and isMain-space-path.test.mjs:
     * Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
     * Update test declarations to accept t parameter.
     * Replace mkdtempSync calls with tmp(t, prefix).
     * Remove manual try/finally blocks, unindenting test bodies.
3. In scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs:
   - Remove all 5 plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/ entries and both plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/ entries from the ALLOWLIST set (completely eradicating both plugins from the allowlist!).
4. Verification:
   - node scripts/run-tests.mjs codex exits 0 with all tests passing.
   - node scripts/run-tests.mjs copilot exits 0 with all tests passing.
   - node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
   - grep -E 'plugins/(adlc-codex|adlc-copilot)/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs returns nothing.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 All 7 test files contain 0 finally blocks.
- AC2 mkdtempSync is not called in any of the 7 test files.
- AC3 grep -E 'plugins/(adlc-codex|adlc-copilot)/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs returns nothing.
- AC4 node scripts/run-tests.mjs codex exits 0.
- AC5 node scripts/run-tests.mjs copilot exits 0.
- AC6 node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC7 adlc rails-guard exits 0.
title: refactor(adlc-codex,adlc-copilot): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate try/finally blocks in Codex and Copilot tests
